import cv2
import numpy as np

def ray_ground(u, v, cam_x, cam_y, heading_deg):
    z_c = 1.55 / ((v - 256) / 256)
    x_c = (u - 256) / 256 * z_c
    theta = np.radians(heading_deg)
    wx = cam_x + z_c * np.sin(theta) + x_c * np.cos(theta)
    wy = cam_y + z_c * np.cos(theta) - x_c * np.sin(theta)
    return wx, wy, z_c

# In obs_0055: cam pos (-1.62, 1.65), heading = 315 deg
img55 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0055.png')
# Blue bottle / vase:
blue55 = (img55[:,:,0] > 150) & (img55[:,:,2] < 50)
yb55, xb55 = np.where(blue55)
print('Blue vase in obs_0055: bottom y =', yb55.max(), 'center x =', np.mean(xb55[yb55 == yb55.max()]))
wx_va, wy_va, z_va = ray_ground(np.mean(xb55[yb55 == yb55.max()]), yb55.max(), -1.62, 1.65, 315)
print(f'Vase from obs_0055: ({wx_va:.2f}, {wy_va:.2f}), dist={z_va:.2f}')

# Sofa in obs_0055:
# Gray armchair:

ys55, xs55 = np.where(sofa55)
print('Sofa in obs_0055: bottom y =', ys55.max(), 'center x =', np.mean(xs55))
wx_so, wy_so, z_so = ray_ground(np.mean(xs55), ys55.max(), -1.62, 1.65, 315)
print(f'Sofa from obs_0055: ({wx_so:.2f}, {wy_so:.2f}), dist={z_so:.2f}')
